API key rotation schedule

API keys rotate every 90 days. Service owners receive a reminder 14 days before expiry. Expired keys are revoked automatically and must be reissued in the admin console.

Incident severity levels

Severity 1: customer-facing outage, page on-call immediately. Severity 2: degraded service, respond within 4 hours. Severity 3: minor issue, triage within 2 business days.
